calculation.description: Average close-location pressure over the prior 20 completed sessions, scaled by upside participation and inversely by realized volatility. Higher values indicate persistent closes near the high, frequent positive returns, and lower noise. The signal is formed only from data available through decision date.
calculation.signal_artifact: Computed by scripts/miner_3_20260813_range_pressure.py from ../persistent/stock_data/{symbol}.csv through 2026-07-15; forward returns are used only for validation.

validation.regime_notes: Positive annual 10-session IC in 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2026; negative in 2020, 2021, and 2025. Predictive power strengthens at the 20-session horizon. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation.
validation.coverage_definition: Average valid instruments divided by 15; dates with at least 8 valid instruments included.
